name: Lost Contact
description: Enemies that lose sight of you for a few seconds stop knowing where you are: they search where they last saw you instead of tracking you across the map. Patrols setting out are aimed to walk past you instead of onto you, and any sent straight at you walk between their own outposts; one that finds you fights as usual. Each on, observe (counts in the log only) or off: lost-contact.ini, Ctrl+F9 / Ctrl+F10 in a mission, or the MODS tab (Mod Options Menu), which needs HD2Runtime and Bingus Shared Loader unless giblett's Vanilla Plus Megapack build is installed. A character kit can limit them while it acts (Lemuen: patrols only). Host or solo.
